Stated Claim / Post Context:
FBI criminal database hacked

=== MULTI-SOURCE TOPIC CLUSTER: FBI criminal database hacked ===

[Source 1 — www.france24.com (Bias: Center / Public Broadcaster)] (URL: https://www.france24.com/en/fbi-criminal-database-hacked):
FBI criminal database hacked

The FBI is investigating a reported major cyberattack targeting its national law enforcement database, the National Crime Information Center (NCIC), which holds sensitive criminal justice records, including information on fugitives, missing persons, criminal histories and stolen property. President Donald Trump said he had just been briefed on the incident, describing it as “not good”. FRANCE 24’s Fraser Jackson reports from Washington DC.

[Source 2 — www.breitbart.com (Bias: Far Right / Populist Nationalist)] (URL: https://www.breitbart.com/2nd-amendment/2026/11/21/hacked-fbi-database-used-firearm-background-checks/):
Hacked: FBI Database Used for Firearm Background Checks

The FBI's National Crime Information Center (NCIC) database, one of the data collections used to conduct background checks on would-be gun purchasers, has been hacked.
The post Hacked: FBI Database Used for Firearm Background Checks appeared first on Breitbart.
